title: Three Winters and One Short Handle
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：fork　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fork 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my grandmother ① laid a fork that no guest in the kitchen would have counted, and she said the laying was the whole of the winter. The ② fork, meaning the tool itself and not the spoon, ran three winters and stayed uncounted in the book; a fork, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ fork in that kitchen had the same short handle beside it, and the ④ fork at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fork, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; my grandmother said the counting is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fork was the whole of the matter, meaning the division and not the tool. The ⑥ fork, meaning the division and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; fork, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a tool and a division. He said the division is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ fork had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short handle. The ⑧ fork of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one kitchen and three winters of counting; fork, she said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to count. She said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fork I remember is the one counted in the plan, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the kitchen. A ⑩ fork, my mother said in 1974, is the only one that improves by being counted; every fork, she said, is a division that has agreed to look like a tool. She said the division was the honest half.

answers.why: lay a fork 意为“摆一把叉子”，1963 年祖母摆了一把厨房里没有一位客人肯数过的叉子。
fork 意为“叉子”，指那一把本身而不是勺子，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被数过。
fork 意为“叉子”，指厨房里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一个短短的柄。
fork 意为“叉子”，指留给孩子们的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fork 意为“分岔、岔口”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这个岔口就是那件事的全部。
fork 意为“分岔”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那把叉子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fork 意为“叉子”，指计划里写到、被数过的那一把，到 1970 年这一把成了计划里的一行。
fork 意为“叉子”，祖母一月写道，整件事的摆叉之事是一间厨房和三个冬天的数过。
fork 意为“叉子”，我记得的是计划里数过的那一把，1972 年结束了，至今仍被说成厨房里最安静的一把。
fork 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一把叉子是唯一会因为被好好数过而变得更好的东西。
